items.title: Taiwan's AI-fueled forecast of 11% GDP growth likely not sustainable, economists say
items.description: Taiwan's economic growth could moderate due to its vulnerability to risks of capex slowdown, macroeconomic downturns, and concentration in semiconductors.

items.title: U.S. bond intervention is like 'paying your mortgage with your credit card,' JPMorgan's Sullivan says
items.description: The U.S. government's efforts to manage pressure in the Treasury market risk merely shifting the problem down the road, according to JPMorgan's James Sullivan.

items.title: Japan's historic yen intervention has ‘turbo-charged’ the carry trade
items.description: Japan's historic effort to prop up the yen may have had an unintended consequence: giving investors a better opportunity to put the carry trade back on.

items.title: Japan headline inflation rate hits highest this year as energy prices bite
items.description: Core inflation — which strips out prices of fresh food but includes energy — was in line with expectations, coming in at 1.8%.

items.title: Chinese humanoid robots' biggest obstacle: humans are still (mostly) better
items.description: Humanoid robots still struggle to perform as efficiently as humans in most labor scenarios.

items.title: Micron CEO pushes back on memory bear case. 3 key takeaways from Cramer's big interview

items.title: CFTC’s Innovation Advisory Committee meeting addresses emerging prediction market risks
items.description: The CFTC's first Innovation Advisory Committee meeting discussed risks of mention markets, with members advocating for tighter consumer protection.

items.title: Warsh faces Fed independence test as Bessent moves in on central bank's turf

items.description: As football season approaches, many Americans are planning to take on debt to pay for tickets, memorabilia, parlays and more.

items.title: Gatekeeping bots, piles of slop: Welcome to the age of AI weirdness at work

items.title: California AG tells CNBC that settling Paramount-WBD lawsuit would require 'robust structural remedies'
